descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S27 Overlap count 0 / 1 / all: no prompt, singular wording, nothing new to add (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 When a day-2 scan overlaps day 1, the app shows 'N patients are already on your list' with an 'add only the new ones' option. … (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 5; TFA-92580 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U5 An overlapping scan leaves existing patients' data untouched. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U6 New patients get a Follow-up badge: scanned ones (including the new ones from a day-2 scan) and manually added ones. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 4; TFA-92580 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Local stack. For each leg, a fresh physician seeded with the day-1 list: Hospital QA Alder 401 300101 · QA Birch 402 300102 · QA Cedar 403 300103; Nursing Home QA Juniper 1938-04-02 Cedar 10 · QA Kale 1941-07-19 Cedar 11 · QA Larch 1945-01-30 Cedar 12. scan-probe mocks the day-2 scan

When Scan a mocked day-2 list: (N=0) four new names only; (N=1) QA Alder / QA Juniper with the same MRN / DOB plus three new names; (all) exactly the day-1 rows

Then N=0: no 'already on your list' prompt, and all 4 are added at Follow-up. N=1: '1 patient is already on your list' (singular; exact wording Q1) with 'add only the new ones', and 3 are added. All: the prompt says 3 are already on the list and offers nothing new, or says there is nothing new to add; 0 are added and the existing charts are untouched. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scan-probe: the prompt text is present or absent per leg; a backend count of each existing name is the same before and after; the added count is 4 / 3 / 0; existing fields (room, diagnosis, unit, DOB, badge) are unchanged. A '0 patients are already on your list' prompt for N=0, an 'add only the new ones' that adds anything for 'all', or a plural '1 patients' is a Fail (wording …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (mocked day-2 scan)) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: probes.
